mapper.sql: t.id, t.parent_id, t.receiver_id, t.sender_id, t.team_code, t.department_code, t.title, t.description, t.delivery_type, t.status, t.priority, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, t.delete_flag

sql.if:
ORDER BY
t.due_date t.priority t.status t.start_date t.title t.created_at
ASC DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks ( parent_id, receiver_id, sender_id, team_code, department_code, title, description, delivery_type, status, priority, start_date, due_date, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag ) VALUES ( #{parentId}, #{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{teamCode}, #{departmentCode}, #{title}, #{description}, #{deliveryType}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumOrdinalTypeHandler}, #{priority, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumOrdinalTypeHandler}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, NOW(), NOW(), ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET receiver_id = #{receiverId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, delivery_type = #{deliveryType}, priority = #{priority, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumOrdinalTypeHandler}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
UPDATE tasks SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

sql.if: AND t.due_date < NOW() AND t.status IN (0, 1)
AND ( LOWER(t.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{request.search}, '%')) OR LOWER(t.description) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{request.search}, '%')) )

mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = 4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} AND status IN (0, 1) AND due_date < NOW()
UPDATE tasks SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
